preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200000 and 1 <= m <= 200000 for n, m in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[0:2]])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (number of nodes) and m (number of queries), each between 1 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[2:2+n]])
preconditions.description: The second line contains n integers a_1, ..., a_n (initial node values), each between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+n-1]]) == n-1 and all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+n-1] for v_i, u_i in [int(x) for x in line.split()])
preconditions.description: The next n-1 lines describe the tree edges as pairs (v_i, u_i), where each node number is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and line.split()[0] in ['1', '2'] and (line.split()[0] == '1' or (line.split()[0] == '2' and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2+n-1:2+n-1+m])
preconditions.description: The next m lines are queries: '1 x val' (add val to node x) or '2 x' (print value of node x), where x is between 1 and n inclusive, and val is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(current_value_of_node(x)) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[2+n-1:2+n-1+m]) if line.split()[0] == '2' for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if i == int(line.split()[1])-1)
postconditions.description: For each query of type '2 x', the output must be the current value of node x after all preceding queries of type '1' have been applied, where current_value_of_node(x) is computed as the initial value a_x plus the sum of all propagated values from ancestor operations.
